Fist Ulthred is a human Flaming Fist at the Last Light Inn. He can help the party during the ⁠Assault on Moonrise Towers.
“
Hey. That's close enough. Artefact or no, I don't like the likes of you crashing our party.
„
— Ulthred, after the party has been cleared.

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Ulthred is at the Last Light Inn's plaza. He arrived at the sanctuary on a mission to rescue  Grand Duke Ravengard. He chats with  Essius next to the fountain, and is suspicious of the party at first, not trusting them the slightest to rescue the Grand Duke from Moonrise. On the other hand, Essius attempts to talk him down and get him to open up to the party's aid. Through his chats with Essius, Ulthred appears to not trust  Jaheira and seems eager to move out rather than sit idly.[1]

If  Marcus is exposed as a True Soul, Ulthred will be  Surprised and join the fight against his summoned Crawling Claws.

Resolve the Abduction

When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap  Isobel during ⁠Resolve the Abduction, Ulthred frequently is amongst the Fists who avoid being  Impaled, and runs up to fight with the Winged Horrors. If Isobel is not saved, he and everyone in Last Light Inn succumb to the Shadow Curse, save for  Jaheira. Ulthred in particular, can be seen agonizingly transforming into a  Shadow-Cursed Undead.

Assault Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the  Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Ulthred, along with the Flaming Fists  Hadenwell,  Helena,  Nipawa and  Rhed survive the first assault and assist the party in the remaining battle against Absolute forces.[2][3]

After the battle, provided he survives, Ulthred and the remaining Fists scout the Moonrise Towers Prison and enter a second battle against the Myrkulites  Duckie Verish,  Sarabayle, and  Willinx Jindlebee, as well as a Death Shepherd and a horde of Necromites. The party can assist the Fists in this optional battle. If the Fists survive, they guard the prison until  Ketheric Thorm is defeated.[4]

After Ketheric Thorm is killed and the party leave for Act Three, Uthred disappears from the game entirely.

  3. ↑ Unlike the Harpers Antony, Essius, Lymn, and Naysa, Ulthred has no failsafe replacement Flaming Fist if he is killed before the assault. There is a Flaming Fist by the name of "Fist Hadenwell" in the game files, referred to as "S_MOO_AssaultFlamingFist_004" not too unlike the other Fists that appear during the assault. It is possible that this Fist was originally conceived as a replacement, or failsafe in the event of an untimely demise for Ulthred.
  4. ↑ Aubree, Gretta, J'ehlar, Rahir, and Ulthred are the only remaining Flaming Fists that can actually be found at Last Light Inn after Florrick and her retinue leave for Baldur's Gate. Despite this, the former three all die in the assault on Moonrise, and are replaced by Helena, Nipawa, and Rhed, while Ulthred survives.
